name: How long does it take to install bathroom trim?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install bathroom trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathroom trim installation typically takes between half a day to two full days, depending on the size of the space and the scope of work. A simple baseboard replacement in a small half-bath can often be finished in just a few hours. However, a full bathroom remodel involving baseboards, window casings, door moldings, and custom crown molding requires extra time for intricate miter cuts, caulking, and multi-coat painting. The schedule also depends on whether old, moisture-damaged trim must be removed and if wall surfaces require patching or leveling before the new trim can sit flush.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most bathroom trim projects take between half a day and two days, depending on room size, whether old trim is being removed, and the detail of the moldings.
